portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* RHEL8.6 - zkey: Fix re-enciphering of EP11 identity key of KMIP plugin (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#2081310)

* RHEL8.4 - genprotimg/check_hostkeydoc: cert. verification is too strict (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#2081311)

* RHEL8.4 - hyptop: observable value fluctuations on initial iteration (s390utils/s390-tools) (BZ#2101809)
